name: vima-tester
description: Web-based API tester for localhost services, powered by the vima-tunneler local agent.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vima/protocol && npm run build -w @vima/relay && npm run build -w @vima/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vima/protocol && npm run test -w @vima/relay
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vima/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @vima/relay && npm run typecheck -w @vima/web
